parsed_profile_json.title: F-CLASS R0 AND R1 PLATFORM ULTRASONIC TESTING
parsed_profile_json.reason_for_revision: To communicate about updated recommendations specific to 7F and 9F R1 platform ultrasonic inspection interval and to update TIL language for clarity.
parsed_profile_json.purpose: To inform affected users about the recommendation to perform in-situ ultrasonic inspection of the R0 and R1 blade platforms for evidence of dovetail distress.
parsed_profile_json.compliance_category_text: Compliance Required - Identifies the need for action to correct a condition that, if left uncorrected, may result in reduced equipment reliability or efficiency. Compliance may be required within a specific operating time.
scope_of_work: Perform in-situ dovetail ultrasonic testing (DT-UT) of R0 and R1 blade platforms to detect dovetail distress.
DT-UT may be performed concurrently with TIL 1509 and TIL 1603 inspections; ultrasonic testing requires rotor rotation.
service_recommendation_line_items: For applicable units with standard/non-enhanced R0 (including P-cut R0) and R1 blades without the platform undercut feature: perform recurrent in-situ DT-UT of R0 suction side and pressure side, and R1 suction side.

For 7F and 9F units: perform R0 and R1 DT-UT at the sooner of 8,000 actual fired hours (FH) or 150 actual fired starts (FS); for peaking units performing more than 150 actual fired starts in a year, conduct DT-UT just before and after the peak season.
For 6F units: perform R0 and R1 DT-UT during the Major Inspection (MI), or at any opportunity when the upper-half compressor casing is removed.
For units with Enhanced Compressor Packages (ECP) 2, 2+, 3 or 4 installed: perform only R1 DT-UT (enhanced R0 blades have the platform undercut feature).
For units with ECP 5 installed: this TIL is not applicable (both enhanced R0 and R1 blades included in ECP 5 have the platform undercut feature).

If DT-UT yields a positive indication: contact GE Gas Power Services to evaluate results; if indications are identified as dovetail cracks, replacement of the entire set of blades may be recommended (R0); if R1 indications are confirmed, send rotor to a GE Service Center to replace the full set of R1 blades.

source_snippets.snippet: This TIL is applicable to select 6F, 7F, and 9F gas turbines with an 18-stage compressor operating with rotor Stage 0 (R0) and Stage 1 (R1) blades that do not have the platform undercut feature.
To inform affected users about the recommendation to perform in-situ ultrasonic inspection of the R0 and R1 blade platforms for evidence of dovetail distress.
GE recommends performing in-situ dovetail ultrasonic testing (DT-UT) of R0 and R1 blades on a recurrent basis to help mitigate the risk of blade liberation due to dovetail distress.

For 7F and 9F units, it is recommended that the R0 and R1 DT-UT be performed the sooner of 8,000 actual fired hours (FH) or 150 actual fired starts (FS). For peaking units performing more than 150 actual fired starts in a year, it is recommended to conduct the DT-UT just before and after the peak season.
For 6F units, it is recommended the R0 and R1 DT-UT be performed during the Major Inspection (MI), or at any opportunity when the upper-half compressor casing is removed.
For units that have installed ECP 5, this TIL is not applicable since both the enhanced R0 and R1 blades included in ECP 5 have the platform undercut feature.
Failure to comply with these recommendations may result in blade liberation and potentially result in downstream compressor distress.
This TIL can be considered complete when the R0 and R1 blades are replaced with blades with platform undercut feature.

Scope of Work
Dovetail ultrasonic testing (DT-UT) may be performed concurrently with TIL 1509 and TIL 1603 inspections. These inspections typically require one to two 12-hour shifts. Ultrasonic testing requires rotor rotation.
